expected_rate: only when a Swing or breakout entry signal fires on a stock where another tier's opposite-side stop rests (mostly a same-session Day lot); can be zero for several sessions
reversal: an entry deferred while no foreign opposite-side stop rested on the symbol (a false block), or a Swing/breakout entry still rejected by Alpaca's wash rule after this change, or a block lasting beyond one session without its daily page
